judge.reason: The assistant correctly answered "1," matching the orchestrator contract (§2) that all Mode-A lenses share one capture with N scorings, and did not run or interview as instructed.

reply:
**1.**

All four lenses (ux, bugs, onboarding, content) score the same kind of capture: a Mode-A journey traversal. The capture step only collects evidence (screenshots, session log, timeline, debrief). The lenses then read that saved evidence afterwards, and none of them opens a browser. So one persona needs one traversal of `https://example-nimbus-notes.test/app`, and all four lenses score it.

The count only goes up if you add something that needs a different capture: another persona (one traversal each), technical (a Mode-B measurement), seo/aeo (a Mode-C crawl), or compare (one capture per site).
